name: ai-task-manager
description: Full-Stack AI Task Manager with Express, MongoDB, Groq AI, React, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
